# anthropic_vault (Data Source)

Get information about a Vault.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_vault" "example" {
  id = "vlt_01HqR2k7vXbZ9mNpL3wYcT8f"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the Vault.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Vault was archived, or null if not archived.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Vault was created.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name for the Vault.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary key-value pairs.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Vault was last updated.
